findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: Setting a hardcoded port name ('COM8') that could be replaced by a malicious port name
findings.assumptions: The code does not handle user input or configuration files to set the port name dynamically, but a future change might introduce such functionality.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: Setting a hardcoded baud rate (115200) that could be replaced by a malicious baud rate
findings.assumptions: The code does not handle user input or configuration files to set the baud rate dynamically, but a future change might introduce such functionality.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: Emitting data that could be used in a future untrusted operation
findings.assumptions: The data read from the serial port could be used in a future operation that might execute commands, but this is not evident from the given code.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: Logging an error string that could be crafted to include malicious content
findings.assumptions: The error string returned by m_serialPort.errorString() could be crafted to include malicious content, but this is not evident from the given code.
